title: Customer groups
description: Segment customers for pricing and promotions.

help.title: About customer groups
help.overview: Groups of customers, such as retail and wholesale, so pricing rules can give each group its own prices. A customer can be in several groups.

sections.title: Each group
items: Manage members adds or removes customers. Only your team can change who is in a group.
A pricing rule that names groups applies only to signed-in customers in them; guests are in no group.
Make default marks the company's default group; it doesn't add anyone by itself.
Deleting a group also ends its memberships; restoring it brings them back.
